text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I spot Satono Diamond talking to a friend in the hallway.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey, Satono! Did you hear about that strange creature that appeared in the field?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Strange creature? No, I haven't heard anything about it.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: There are rumors going around saying it was a cryptid—the famous Humungo Argentum Cicada Dragon!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: …A-are you okay? You're not reacting like you usually would…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …Oh, yes, I'm fine! Sorry. I just zoned out a little bit…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'd have never imagined such a subdued reaction from the ever inquisitive Satono Diamond… Perhaps revising her race schedule would ease her fatigue.
